aboutSection.content:
Headquartered at B-366, Ashok Nagar, Shahdara, Delhi – 110093, ARCH NEW ERA DESIGN (technical identity NRBL TECH) is a full-spectrum Architecture, Civil Construction, Interior Designing, and Turnkey Solutions firm. We believe that every residence and commercial space should be a harmonious blend of intelligent space planning, earthquake-resistant structural engineering, and uplifting interior aesthetics.

Whether you are building a new residential home from the ground up, developing a luxury farmhouse, or revitalizing your living and workspace interiors, our multidisciplinary studio handles every detail under one accountable leadership.
highlights: Single-Point Accountability from Architectural Blueprint to Key Handover
Transparent Per Sq. Ft. Pricing with Verified Brand Specifications
Vastu-Compliant Spatial Design Tailored for Modern Urban Living
Dedicated Civil Engineers, Interior Designers & Site Supervisors
aboutSection.founderMessage: At ARCH NEW ERA DESIGN (NRBL TECH), our philosophy is simple: 'Thoughtful Design. Stronger Structure. Brighter Lives.' Every home we design and build is treated as a legacy for the family living inside it. We focus on natural light, structural longevity, honest materials, and spaces that bring good energy.
aboutSection.mission: To deliver architect-designed, structurally superior, and transparently priced construction and interior solutions that elevate everyday living across Delhi NCR.
aboutSection.vision: To be the most trusted name in modern architecture, turnkey construction, and luxury interior craftsmanship known for ethical practices and timeless design.

services.name: Architecture & Planning
services.shortDescription: Bespoke 2D floor plans, 3D exterior elevations, structural RCC drawings, Vastu layouts, and municipal sanction planning.
services.fullDescription:
Our Architecture & Planning studio at ARCH NEW ERA DESIGN (NRBL TECH) transforms raw plots into intelligent, inspiring architectural blueprints. We balance aesthetics, climate responsiveness, Vastu principles, and structural engineering so your building is both visually iconic and practically effortless to live in.

Every architectural package includes detailed 2D furniture layouts, working civil drawings, column-footing structural schedules, plumbing & electrical (MEP) blueprints, and photorealistic 3D front elevations.

Photorealistic 3D Exterior Facade & Night-Lighting Elevations
Seismic-Safe RCC Structural Framing & Foundation Drawings
Detailed Electrical, Plumbing, Drainage & HVAC Working Drawings
Sun-Path, Natural Ventilation & Space Optimization Analysis

blogs.title: Complete Guide to House Construction Cost per Sq. Ft. in Delhi NCR (2026)
blogs.shortDescription: Understand the breakdown between Essential (₹1,099/sq.ft.), Ready-to-Move (₹1,399/sq.ft.), and Premium Turnkey (₹1,899/sq.ft.) residential construction packages.
blogs.content:
Understanding Residential Construction Costs in Delhi NCR

Planning to build your dream home in Delhi NCR requires a clear understanding of where every rupee goes—from excavation and RCC structural framing to finishing materials and modular interiors. At ARCH NEW ERA DESIGN (NRBL TECH), led by Nidhi Sharma, we believe in transparent, stage-wise cost planning.

1. Essential Home Construction (Starting at ₹1,099/sq. ft.)

Designed for homeowners who want an uncompromising, earthquake-resistant civil structure with reliable standard finishes. Roughly 55% of the budget is invested in the RCC frame, foundation, TMT steel, cement, and brickwork, while 45% covers essential flooring, doors, windows, plumbing, and electrical wiring.

2. Ready-to-Move Package (Starting at ₹1,399/sq. ft.)

Ideal for modern urban families looking for upgraded specifications, large-format vitrified tiles, granite staircases, 3D front elevation execution, UPVC windows, and modular kitchen provisions.

3. Premium Turnkey Package (Starting at ₹1,899/sq. ft.)

Our single-window flagship offering where our architects, civil engineers, and interior designers handle everything—from soil testing and 3D renders to complete modular kitchens, floor-to-ceiling wardrobes, false ceilings, and luxury bath fittings.

Key Factors That Influence Your Final Quotation

  • Plot Accessibility & Soil Conditions: Corner plots, narrow lanes, or deep foundation requirements.
  • Stilt Parking & Lift Provisions: Multi-storey builder floor norms in Delhi.
  • Brand Selections: Choice of sanitaryware, flooring marble/tile sizes, and woodwork finishes.

Have a plot in Shahdara, East Delhi, or anywhere in NCR? Contact Nidhi Sharma at +91 7535942407 for a free architectural and cost consultation.

blogs.title: 7 Interior Design Elements That Bring Good Energy & Luxury to Modern Homes
blogs.shortDescription: How natural daylight, Vastu spatial flow, warm lighting layers, and bespoke woodwork transform everyday living spaces.
blogs.content:
Spaces That Bring Good Energy

A truly luxurious interior is not just about expensive materials—it is about how a space makes you feel the moment you step inside. At ARCH NEW ERA DESIGN (NRBL TECH), our guiding statement is "Spaces That Bring Good Energy."

1. Unobstructed Entryways & Foyer Consoles

The entrance foyer sets the energetic tone of your residence. A clean wooden or metal louver partition paired with warm concealed lighting creates privacy while welcoming positive energy.

2. Layered Architectural Lighting

Instead of harsh overhead tubes, combine 3000K warm-white peripheral cove lighting, focused COB spotlights for artwork and textured walls, and statement chandeliers over dining zones.

3. Ergonomic Clutter-Free Modular Kitchens

Using BWP marine plywood, soft-close tandem drawers, and tall pantry pull-outs keeps countertops completely clear and effortless to maintain.

4. Full-Height Wardrobes & Warm Textures

Floor-to-ceiling wardrobes eliminate dust traps and visually heighten bedrooms, while fluted panels and cane/veneer accents add organic warmth.

Our complete Interior Designing solutions start at ₹900/sq. ft. Reach out to Nidhi Sharma at B-366, Ashok Nagar, Shahdara, Delhi for a personalized 3D design consultation.

blogs.title: Why Architect-Led Turnkey Construction Saves Time, Money & Structural Risk
blogs.shortDescription: Discover why hiring an integrated architecture and construction firm prevents rework, cost overruns, and design compromises.
blogs.content:
The Problem with Fragmented Construction

Many property owners hire an independent draughtsman for plans, a local contractor for civil work, and separate carpenters for interiors. Without unified supervision, structural columns clash with interior layouts, plumbing lines get chiselled repeatedly, and budgets spiral out of control.

The Architect-Led Turnkey Advantage at ARCH NEW ERA DESIGN

When your architect and structural team also lead the on-site execution:

  • Zero Design-to-Site Translation Loss: The exact 3D elevation proportions and interior electrical points are built into the civil shuttering stage.
  • Verified Material Quality: Every batch of TMT steel, cement, wiring, and marine plywood is checked against the agreed specification schedule.
  • Predictable Handover Timeline: Civil, MEP, false ceiling, and modular carpentry teams work in a synchronized sequence.
